status: documentary candidate 0.4 with proposed numeric controls and optimization; not frozen, registered, implemented or trained
scope: Retrospective comparison of price-history representations for a GPT-like forecaster; scientific raw reference prices only

data.vintage: downloaded 2026-10-14; historical initial releases not verified
data.use: exploratory; no claim of untouched confirmatory test
data.point_in_time_scope: conditional on the revised snapshot; not a certified real-time replay

information_contract_p1a.context_at_origin_i: P[i-255:i+1] and past publication dates only
information_contract_p1a.normalization: x64[j;i] = log(P[j]/P[i]) / s[i], calculated in float64; x32 = float32(x64)
information_contract_p1a.scale: s[i] = max(population_std of the last 64 observed log increments ending at i, 1e-6)
common_side_information: one exact P[i] per asset and origin
one s[i] per asset and origin
forbidden_side_channels: exact anchor for every historical observation
normalization over target or full dataset
per-observation continuous scale that is not part of the declared input
information_contract_p1a.loss_positions: only targets strictly after origin i
information_contract_p1a.common_numeric_parent: C receives x32; all quantized codes are calculated from the same x32 promoted exactly to float64
derived_metadata: past publication calendar gap in days
information_contract_p1a.first_source_date_gap_sentinel: 0 means no predecessor; not an observed zero-day interval

representations.C: continuous x32; two-parameter-per-dimension affine scalar encoder
representations.Q: k=floor(8*float64(x32)), m=(2*k+1)/16, exact float32 midpoint under declared k bound; affine scalar encoder
representations.F: Raw flat cell code; F+ learned encoder N(m)+T[k] in core, N(m) outside; symbolic corrections initialized zero
representations.H: Raw coarse-plus-three-bits code; H+ learned encoder N(m)+A[q]+sum(Bj[bj]) in core, N(m) outside; symbolic corrections initialized zero
representations.main_p1a_context_token_count: one fused local representation per observation; local encoder cost is counted
representations.integer_division: floor division, including for negative integers
representations.canonical_escape_serialization: ESC, mandatory sign, decimal absolute integer without leading zeros, END; no negative zero
representations.escape_model_treatment: P1-A local decoding to midpoint; same within-model affine N(m) on EVERY observation, with no symbolic correction outside core; models do not share trained weights
representations.out_of_bound_policy: Stop and amend precision before scoring; no silent clipping or row removal
representations.same_information_scope: Raw canonical Q/F/H codes plus common metadata, conditional on precision audit; no injectivity guarantee after learned embeddings
representations.symbolic_correction_initialization: All rows of T/A/B exactly zero; never-visited rows must remain zero under chosen optimizer
representations.paired_initialization_requirement: Within a seed, Q/F+/H+ share initial numeric-base and backbone values, not trained parameters
representations.local_compute_not_unchanged: Numerical base now evaluated in core too for F+/H+; measure actual compute later
representations.pure_symbolic_02_status: Archived design; not universally rejected, but separate escape branch cannot be treated as trained

outputs.physical_target: future ECB reference price in original unit
outputs.common_head: 21 affine outputs from the last context state; per horizon z1 free, successive z values add softplus(raw); q=P[i]*exp(s[i]*sqrt(h)*z)
outputs.primary_evaluation_loss: mean pinball over seven quantiles, horizon 1, per-origin division by P[i]*s[i], then equal asset weight
outputs.candidate_training_loss: Equal mean over three horizons and seven quantiles, each pinball divided by P[i]*s[i]*sqrt(h); equal asset weight

comparisons.representation_first: shared parameters, target asset history only
comparisons.H1: local versus globally shared; report both equal total compute and equal target exposure
comparisons.H2: same multivariate architecture separately trained with observed other assets or their mask

capacity_note: Approximate block counts retained for history; exact totals are conditional on the documentary minimal architecture and encoder above. Same backbone does not mean equal total parameters or compute. Revision 0.3 reuses the former escape affine as the always-used numerical base, preserving counts but changing computation.

inference.unit: paired per-origin loss vector across all six assets

open_before_freeze: Validate proposed initialization gradients, finite price outputs, numerical precision and actual compute in a future implementation phase
Evaluate budget adequacy and define convergence/scaling decision rules without cherry-picking
Non-additive hierarchical sensitivity and cross-asset H2 architecture
Independent evaluation corpus, vintage qualification, minimum relevant effect and power assessment
Independent critical review when service becomes available
amendment_reason: User requested a research plan and its initial execution. Define stronger numerical controls and a proposed exposure/tuning budget; no forecast results used.

minimal_architecture.scope: Shared-parameter single-asset-context P1-A only; cross-asset H2 architecture not specified here
minimal_architecture.core: Pre-norm causal dense Transformer; standard biased Q/K/V and output projections; biased d->4d->d GELU MLP; two affine LayerNorms per block
minimal_architecture.position: fixed sinusoidal, no trained positional parameters
minimal_architecture.metadata_projection: affine four-to-d: log current price, log current scale, log1p past calendar gap, escape flag; 5*d parameters

baselines.status: documentary definitions only; not implemented or fitted
baselines.information: Unquantized own history for B0/B1/B1m/B2/B3-own; six histories for B3-cross in H2 only
baselines.B1: P[i]*exp(s[i]*sqrt(h)*Phi_inverse(tau)); zero log drift, not price martingale

B2.quantile: linear interpolation with index (n-1)*tau in terminal-price space, not log space

B3.features_per_available_asset: last 20 log increments divided by current s plus log(current s)
B3.fit: separate target asset and horizon; mean squared error + alpha*sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized
B3.scaling: fit-only column mean and population std; zero-variance column set to zero with scale 1
B3.residual_fit_cutoff: For year y use fitting origins whose h target date is strictly before Jan 1 of y; predict common-cohort origins whose target stays in year y
B3.residual_quantiles: pool chronological out-of-fit residuals separately by asset/horizon/alpha/own-cross; linear interpolation in standardized residual space
B3.final_fit: all admissible 1999-2009 training origins, retaining chronological residual quantiles
B3.alpha_selection: mean primary h1 development score, equal assets; one alpha per own-cross variant for all assets/horizons; largest alpha for exact tie
B3.pseudo_test_policy: freeze coefficients, scalers, alpha and residual quantiles before pseudo-test; no refitting on its targets

arithmetic_verification.scope: Documentary arithmetic verification only; constructed examples; no market dataset read

freeze.scope: Freeze of descriptive preflight analysis only, not registration or freezing of P1-D predictive protocol

extended_numeric_controls.primary_contrast_unchanged: Q versus H+; conclusion explicitly conditional on affine Q
extended_numeric_controls.extended_comparisons: Full numeric controls reported, no uncorrected confirmatory inference from post-hoc best comparator

proposed_initialization.shared_draws: Per seed and size, common core/metadata/base/head weights; independent named random streams for components so extra arms do not shift common draws
proposed_initialization.symbol_corrections: zero; unvisited rows must remain zero
proposed_initialization.head_bias_rule: first z direct; inverse_softplus of positive consecutive gaps for remaining six; repeated per horizon
proposed_initialization.gradient_caveat: zero output matrices delay gradients into upstream components until those matrices change

proposed_optimization.decay_scope: ordinary matrices, base weights and embeddings; exclude biases and normalization gains
proposed_optimization.schedule: linear warmup over first 5% of optimizer updates, cosine to 10% of peak over remainder; final checkpoint only for selection
proposed_optimization.reference_precision: float32 model; float64 preprocessing as existing contract; mixed precision deferred
proposed_optimization.date_shuffle: new permutation of all training origin dates each epoch, same schedule across paired arms
proposed_optimization.selection: per arm/size, minimize average h1 development score across 2 tuning seeds, final checkpoint, equal assets; exact tie smaller lr
proposed_optimization.nonfinite_tuning_rule: any scientific numerical failure makes that lr inadmissible for the arm; all failed -> no selected model
proposed_optimization.repeat_failure_rule: retain failures, no replacement seed; incomplete robustness assessment
proposed_optimization.hardware_retry: same configuration and state; scientific changes require amendment
